1. General Description
The SKW92A module includes an 802.11n
MAC and baseband, a 2.4GHz radio and FEM,
a 580MHz MIPS CPU, a 5-port 10/100 fast
Ethernet switch. Solution for low power,

Ethernet switch. Solution for low power,
low-cost, and highly integrated AP router and
consumer electronic devices, the module
requires only an external 3.3V power supply. It
supports 802.11n operating up to 144 Mbps for
20 MHz and 300 Mbps for 40 MHz channel Figure 1: SKW92A Top View
respectively, and IEEE 802.11b/g data rates.
The module supports bridge mode and AP 3. Features

◆ Support interface: I2C, PCM,
◆ USB WiFi Camera I2S(192K/24bits), PWM, SPI slave, UART lite,
◆ IOT (internet of things) GPIO.
◆ WiFi AP ◆ Security: WEP64/128, TKIP, AES, WPA,
